scripts.dev: concurrently "cd sugoiHub/backend && npm run dev" "cd sugoiHub/frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: cd sugoiHub/frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd sugoiHub/backend && npm run lint" "cd sugoiHub/frontend && npm run lint"
